tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i bskor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i dkyil 'khor bsdus pa'i rtog pa le'u

tha ma bco lnga pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos he badz+ra'i bstan pa bsrung zhing 'phel ba'i phyir nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi sku gsung dang thugs rdo rje las phyung ngo*// de nyid bskyed pa hūm̐ yig las skyes pa// lag pa gnyis pa mgo gcig ldan pa// kha dog nag cing cher 'bar ba po drag po che// 'bar ba'i gri gug g.yas dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin// mgo bo rlon pa'i phreng ba lnga bcus do shal byas// 'jigs byed nag po mche ba gtsigs// gzugs thung gzi brjid chen po nyid// kha nas khrag ni 'dzag pa po/ /de lta bu'i dam tshig pa de la ye shes pa gzhug cing*/ mngon spyod bya ba'i yul/ slob dpon la smad cing bstan pa la rtag tu gang sdang dang*// dkon mchog gsum la khro bas 'khrugs dang ldan dang*// sems can du ma gsod byed pa rnams/ /sdig can rang gi yan lag sha bcad nas// nag po chen pos za bar 'gyur// khrag gi rgyun yang 'thung bar byed// yang na de'i mgo bo'i steng 'dug nas// til tsam du ni gcod par byed/ /med thabs med pa chang dang shis byed 'bru chen dang*/ mon sran dre'u// me tog nag po bdug spos dang byug pa dang*/ /gtor ma'i rgyu sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga nyid kyi// gtor mas nag po chen po mchod/ /cing bsnyen sgrub las sbyor 'dis bya/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya/ nag po chen po shā sa na bstan pa la/ u pa hā ri ṇi nye bar 'tshe ba sgrub pa e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo phyi ma min pa'i dus 'dir a yaṃ i daṃ de 'di rnams rat+na tra yā ya/ dkon mchog gsum la a pa ka ri ṇi gnod par byed pa rnams ya di pra ti dz+nyā gal te dam bcas pa bzhin sma ra si ta taṃ dran pa de'i tshe i daṃ 'di duṣ+ṭaṃ gdug pa can kha kha zo zo khā hi khā hi nges par zo nges par zo/ mā ra mā ra

sod sod/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa zungs zungs ban+dha ban+dha chings chings ha na ha na rgyob rgyob/ da ha da ha sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa tshos tshos/ dī na me ke na mā ra ya nyi ma gcig la sod/ mā ra ya'i gong du bsgrub bya gang yin pa de'i ming sbyar/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ tsha ba gsum ste sga/ pi ling*/ na le sham gsum gyis dgra bo'i gzugs brnyan byas pa'i lus la dug dang ske tshes cho ga bzhin du ste sgrub pa'i dus su ske tshe/ shang tshe/ lang tang tses gro ga'am shog bu la 'khor lo bri/ snying gar ming rus bri/ gzugs de'i snying gar gzhug de nas de'i lus brub khung du bzhag la/ de'i steng du mgon po bskyed/ spyan drangs/ de la las gzhol/ rtags byung nas las sbyor phur pas gdab cing kha sbyor phye la bsreg pa ni tsher mas bkang ba'i me la gong gi ming dang bcas pa bsro bar byas na/ de de'i mod la mi mthong bar 'gyur ro// paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang*/ lo tsā ba 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyi 'gyur las bris pa'o// zhes gsungs so// bla ma dam pa rgyal tsha lung mang po khu dbon gyi phyag dpe las/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis klu'i dgon par zhus gtugs bgyis pa'o// ༈ /sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la sā dha naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i mgon po 'di la sgrub lugs bzhi ste/ bka' sdod dang*/ tshogs bdag dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ gshin rje'o// oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ de ni bka' sdod do// oṃ ma hā kā la ye ha na ha na badz+ri ṇa swā hā/ de ni tshogs bdag tu sgrub pa'o// de la tshogs bdag ni rgya nag po'i lugs can gos lhab lhub gri dang thod pa can no// oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ de ni gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā la rū pa sha hūm̐ phaṭa/

de ni gshin rje ltar bsgrub pa'o// de la 'di ni bka' sdod du sgrub pa yin no// sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// tshul khrims sogs ldan bsdu dngos bzhis// sems can don byed brtson 'grus ldan// rtag tu sgrub la brtson pa yis// slob dpon la smod bstan la sdang*/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig las 'chal bas sems can mang po la 'tshe zhing mtshams med byed// de rnams bsgral bar bya ba yin// gzhan du dam tshig nyams par 'gyur// dang por bdag nyid yi dam lhar// rim pa thams cad bzlas pa'i bar du rdzogs bsgoms la// bstan pa bsrung phyir nag po mchod// ri rab brag steng dkyil 'khor gru gsum nag /pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ skyes 'od zer mi bzod pa 'bar ba nag po che// gri gug thod pa lag na thogs// mgo bo'i phreng bas do shal byas// mche gtsigs gzugs thung gzi brjid che// kha nas khrag 'dzag khros tsam na/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i rtags rang gi yan lag sha gcod byed/ /gri gug gi yu bas khrag gi rgyun yang 'jib par byed// slob dpon la smod pa bstan la sdang*// mtshams med la sogs te sems can mang po la 'tshe ba byed rnams kyi// de rnams mgo nas sprul pa mang pos til tsam za// de ltar bdag dam tshig par gsal bar bsams nas ni// rang gi gnas te rdo rje 'chang ngam rnam snang gi thugs ka nas spyan drang bya// rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas ltar// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru// drag po'i las la spyan 'dren bzhugs// myur bar 'ongs pa de la bstim/ /dam bzhag gsum dang mchod pa byas la/ /mon sran dre'u dzam bu ti/ ste 'bras chan dang sran chan dang sran ma 'dres pa'i gtor ma/ /me tog bdug spos sha lnga dang*// bdud rtsi lnga sbyar man ngag bzhin gtor ma sbyin// oṃ ma hā kā la ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na/ u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇi/ ya di pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta taṃ/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na ma ke na sarba duṣ+ṭā na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nag po chen po khyod kyis sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa bzhin du/ bdag cag rnams kyis las ci bcol ba bzhin du gyis shig gal te de ltar ma byas na mgo bo ardza ka'i dog pa ltar tshal par 'gas par 'gyur ro/ */'di rnams cho 'phrul chung na ma gtogs bya mi dgos/ byas na slar mkha' 'gro nus pa nyams su 'gro gsungs/ dam chu blud la lag tu rdo rje sbyin/ de nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa'i// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// mdog nag gzugs thung gzi brjid che// gdug pa tshar gcod gri gug g.yas// g.yon na gdug pa'i khrag bkang snod// thod phreng can la bdag bstod do// khros pa'i zhabs brdabs sa gzhi g.yo// 'jigs pa'i gad mos ri rab sgyel// dam tshig nyams pa'i snying 'byin pa'i// dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ */myur bar 'dod na 'di nyid kyis bstod do// 'jam par 'dod na las byang nas byung bas bstod do// de nas gtor ma la phud cig phul la/ bar 'dir las byang bzhin bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa thon pa dang*/ yang khrag dang phud bsres la gtor ma la phul nas bskul pa bya ste/ hūm̐/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// bstan pa bsrung bar sems bskyed pa// nag po khyod ni yin pa ste// gdug pa tshar gcod 'jigs pa'i gzugs// ral pa nag po gyen du brdzes// steng gi lha tshogs 'jigs par byed// spyan bgrad ljags 'dril bar gyi lha gdon bsdigs// g.yas pa'i gri gug gnod sems can la sdang*// g.yon pa'i thod khrag gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol// zhabs brdabs gnod sems can gyi lus la nyed// gang zhig dkon mchog gsum khro dang*// bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe// bdag gis bsgo ba kun khug la// liṅga 'di la myur du chug

/de yi sha zo khrag la 'thungs// rus pa klad pa nang khrol zo// rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /mdza' ba kun dang phrol la thongs// bdag gis bsgo ba ma nyan na// nag po khyod ni nyams par 'gyur// ces bskul lo/ /bar 'dir dam la bzhag pa/ mna' chu blud pa/ rdo rje sbyin pa gsum bya/ 'di mkha' 'gro gshegs kha yin pas nus pa la mi gnod gsungs so/ /gong gi sngags sam/ yang na/ oṃ ma hā kā la che ge mo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ stong rtsa brgyad bzla/ nag po chen po gshegs/ gtor chung gshegs/ gnas gsum bsrung ngo*/ /de nas sbyor ba bshad par bya// tsha ba gsum dang rkang rjes rdul la gzugs brnyan bya/ /bri ba'i snag tshal dug dang ske tshe lan tshwa dang*// tshwa gsum smyo byed srin lag khrag /bsres pas 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dam/ yang na las byang bzhin zur drug pa byas la mu khyud la sngags ring gis bskor te lte ba dang rtsibs dang gong ras rnams la che ge mo dhi na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bris la bya'o/ /gong bar sngags spel gzugs brnyan gyi snying gar gzhug /dug gi tsher mas lus la dgang*// dur khrod me 'am yang na 'bras phub la bdugs rtsa ba'i sngags bzlas na// de ma thag tu nad la sogs pas thebs nas med par 'gyur/ /'di man chad dur khrod nag po na gsal lo/ /yang na rabs chad thod pa ru// bcug la gri yi dur bcug na// the tshom med par gang bsgo 'grub// klu yod gnas su gang bsgo 'grub// nag po'i 'phan nam rgyal mtshan la// sngags dang ming spel byas nas ni// rdzas kyi byugs te rab sbyar te// mchod rten btags na gang bsgo 'grub// gang 'dod tshul gyi lha rten gnas// nag po bskyed la gtor ma sbyin// gong gsum bzlas pa tshar bar bya// yul 'dir thog ser myur du phob// bsgo na myur du 'bebs par byed// de ru gtor ma gter du sba// de yis kyang ni gang bsgo byed// yul lha'i steng du nag po bzhag

/de yi sngags bzlas phur bu ni// yul lha'i snying gar gdab par bya// des ni the tshom med par 'grub// khyi yi thod pa sha med par// sngags dang ming spel dgra khyim sba// de yis kyang ni gang bsgo byed// thal ba'am yungs kar gang rung la// bzlas nas gtor bas ser sogs chad// de sogs nag po chen po yi// sbyor ba'i yon tan brjod mi nus// nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrar+dhā ka ra warma dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba'o// nag po chen po'i gzhung 'di sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma'i phyag dpe/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i phyag na bzhugs pa las/ bla ma do pa ston tshul gyis bris pa/ bla ma dam pa rgyal tsha lung mang po'i phyag dpe las/ sa chen gyi mchan dang bcas legs par bris pa'o// dus phyis bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du gzigs phul te/ mngon par bsngags pa mdzad cing phyag dpe dang 'dra bsdur te mthun par snang zhing yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal gyis zhus gtugs bgyis pa'o// ༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral lha gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// bla ma yi dam chos skyong la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gtor bsngos grub nas/ slob ma la rjes gnang bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod me tog bkram nas/ slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do// 'o khyed rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu ba de legs/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba yi dam gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba rnams tshar nas/

slob ma'i bya ba rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul tshar ba dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// sogs nas/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// sogs sh+lo la gcig lan gsum brjod/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal kye rdo rje la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags mdzad snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ de nas rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs lan gsum/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon khyed kyis bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba'i ched du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas dngos gzhi la/ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la phog tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bar du gcod pa thams cad dang rnam smin sha rus dang bcas pa thams cad mi dmigs te stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ swa bhā wa brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du khyed rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing nag cig tu gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje nag po chen po cher 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag ces pa nas hūm̐ dang bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa'i lcam dral gnyis kyi skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar gtor chog ltar brjod/ de nas gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka dang*/ khyad par 'og min gyi gnas nas rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po'i thugs ka nas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ slob ma la gu gul gyis bdug slob dpon gyis dril bu gsil/ shā sa na dang*/ ro ru sogs lan gsum brjod/ gzhan yang rnga dang cha lang la sogs pa'i sgra yang bya ste/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun gyi nag po chen po lcam dral gyi thugs kar phog mgon po'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung zhal nas thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa na sogs dang*/ yi ge bcu gnyis ma/ yi ge bdun ma rnams lan gsum gyi rjes zlos dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas kyang sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi g.yon gyi lha mo'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bh+yoḥl thim par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ro ru sogs lan gsum/ de nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs lan gsum byas la/ me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas blugs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ rig pa 'dzin pa 'di'i rgyud la dpal nag po chen po lcam dral gyi gsung gi rjes su gnang ba dang byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig

ces brjod la me tog mgo bor bzhag thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed mgon po lcam dral gyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas thugs ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ gri gug thod pa/ gaṇ+ḍi/ ral gri/ mdung*/ rtse gsum pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung nas khyed rang gi thugs kar thim par mos pa mdzod byas la slob dpon gyis dril bu dkrol/ shā sa na la sogs pa'i sngags rnams lan gcig brjod/ de nas mgon po lcam dral gyi sku gsung thugs dang*/ khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ lcam dral gyi gtor ma slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag la/ gtor ma 'di khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag pa'i tshe dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral du mos la/ de'i spyi bo nas yar bla ma brgyud pa rnams tho brtsegs su bzhugs par mos te/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pas/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyis gcig car du gsungs pas phrin las thams cad bsgrubs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya sma ra sogs ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya sma ra sogs nas rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrar+dhā ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ gu rub rin chen bsod nams/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

mthun rkyen thams cad bsgrub pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig ces bya/ de nas chos skyong lcam dral khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pa'i mos pa byas la/ gtor ma gral la bzhag rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rjes gnang 'di thob pa'i bla ma la mos gus bsgom/ chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ba la brtson par bya'o// bya nag dang khyi nag la gnod 'tshe mi bya'o// de nas gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs lan gsum brjod du gzhug de nas rjes gnang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum byed du gzhug de nas slob dpon gyis gtor mgron la yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bzod par gsol ba dang*/ gshegs gsol bya zhing*/ rang la bsrung ba dang*/ bkra shis bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// ༈ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang bya tshul blo yi mun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na shrī wā ne/ bla ma mchog dang kye yi rdo rje yi// thugs las sprul pa'i bstan srung kun gyi gtso// nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor bcas kyi// rjes gnang bya tshul bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri// de la 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi rjes su gnang ba'i cho ga la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing bkra shis pa'i gnas su 'di'i bris sku sogs bkram pa'i mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du gtor ma zlum gtor lnga rgyan ci mdzes dang*/ de dag la dar gyi cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang*/ yang de'i mdun du mgon po'i skong gtor dzaṃ bshos lta bu la mar gyi nyi zla nor bu phyag mtshan me ri sogs rgyan ci mdzes brgyabs pa la dar nag gi cod pan gyis brgyan pa/

de'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ me tog slob ma la ster rgyu'i nas nag maṇ+ḍal/ gu gul sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bkod pa ci mdzes su bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la slob dpon gyis dpal kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar dang*/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod sogs kyis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa sogs nas rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba bkra shis kyi bar gtor chog mdzes rgyan ltar grub rjes/ bdun nam bcu gcig la sogs pa grangs kha yar ba kye rdo rje dbang thob pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'am/ sel bar byed pa'i ched du dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhus la dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan rgyu'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa dang*/ khams dang*/ bag la nyal dang rjes su mthun par chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes dang*/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos sdom gsum rab dbye las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la ni// rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang zhes gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa byed pa'i gang zag rnams la bdud rigs kyi lha rnams kyi 'tshe ba'i bar chad byed pa yin pas/

bar chad de dag zlog pa'am srung bar byed pa la chos skyong khyad 'phags re bsten dgos pa yin te/ de'ang 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma gnyis las/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i srung ma pho lha dang*/ mo lha dang*/ zhang lha la sogs pa bsten kyang tshe 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad phra mo tsam sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen cung zad tsam bsgrub nus kyang mthar thug byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen byang chub bsgrub par mi nus pas bsten kyang don chung ba yin te/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen pos/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings gyur na// 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus// zhes snying rje'i bsam pas gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs/ bsten cing srung skyob byed pa'i lha ma yin pas/ skyabs su bsten na skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal bar bshad pa yin te/ mdo las/ gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs song ba// de ni yang dag dge bsnyen te// nam du'ang lha ni gzhan dag la// skyabs su 'gro ba ma yin no// zhes gsungs pa ltar bsten kyang dgos pa chung ba yin no// gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma la'ang pha rol tu phyin pa'i rigs kyi srung ma ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis gzhes pa'i dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa ste/ de rnams bsten pas don 'grub par bshad kyang*/ de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje theg pa nas gsungs pa'i srung ma re bsten dgos pa yin te/ de'ang bya rgyud nas gsungs pa'i srung ma dang*/ spyod rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med nas gsungs pa'i srung ma dang bzhi las 'dir phyi ma yin/ de la'ang pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis su med pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i srung ma gsum las 'dir phyi ma yin/

de la'ang 'dir dpal kye rdo rje'i bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje gur gyi rgyud le'u bco lnga pa las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las rdo rje nag po chen po 'di phyung ngo*// hūm̐ gi yi ge las skyes pa// zhes sogs gsal bar gsung la/ mgon po mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ mgon po phyag gnyis pa nas/ phyag 'bum pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs gsungs pa las/ phyag gnyis pa 'di nyid rgyas par bstan pa yin cing*/ dur khrod nag po'i rgyud las/ lha lnga ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur tshul dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya cher bshad la/ rgyud de rnams la brten nas rje btsun sa skya pa rnams la mgon po'i bka' babs rnam pa bzhi bzhugs te/ brgyud pa'i bshad srol dang po ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra nas 'brog mi lo tsā ba la brgyud pa 'di rdo rje gur le'u bco lnga par sgrub thabs gsungs la/ de'i 'grel ba gur rgyan du bsnyen sgrub las gsum tshang ba'i man ngag cig bshad/ 'di la man ngag zur pa gcig yod kyang*/ gur rgyan las phyung ba yin no// las tshogs la gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang rbod gtong zlog pa'i man ngag rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa zlog pa'i man ngag srung 'khor bris nas rang srung ba'i man ngag dang gsum/ dang po la dbye na srung zlog bsad gsum gyi man ngag gsum du 'gyur ro// 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung la sogs pa rnams bka' srol ma nyams par bzhugs so// brgyud pa'i bka' babs gnyis pa ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rdo rje nas ba ri lo tsā ba la brgyud pa mgon po rkyang pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ de'i sgrub thabs bram ze mchog sred kyis mdzad pa rgya gzhung rtsod med sgrub thabs brgya rtsa na bzhugs pa/ de'i sa bcad rje btsun gyi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i ṭī ka'i nang na yod cing*/ de rnams kyi rjes gnang lung dang bcas pa deng sang gi bar du bka' ma chad par yod do// brgyud pa'i bka' srol gsum pa ni/

paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shrar+dhā ka ra warma nas lo chen rin chen bzang po dang mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa 'di man ngag gzhan las rgyas shing*/ mnga' ris stod du bon po mang po la drag las byas pas man ngag lag len ma nyams par yod pas brgyud pa 'di la thugs rtsis che bar mdzad cing*/ 'di la'ang rkyang sgrub dang sbags sgrub la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag dang*/ mgon po lha bcu gnyis ma/ lha lnga ma rnams kyi dbang bskur ba dang*/ lcam dral lha gsum dang*/ lha brgyad dang*/ lha bcu gnyis ma dang*/ 'khor rkyang gi rjes gnang phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas par bzhugs pa yin no// brgyud pa'i bka' babs bzhi pa ni/ kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī las chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas gsan pa bram ze mchog sred kyi gzhung dang*/ de'i man ngag gsang sgrub spu gri skor gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i lung dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin no// de la'ang lugs dang po gnyis dang*/ phyi ma rnams la ni pho rkyang du sgrub pa'i las tshogs cung zad ma gtogs rgya cher mi snang zhing*/ mal lo tsā ba'i lugs zhes grags pa 'di nyid la sgrub tshul gyi rnam gzhag rkyang sgrub dang sbags sgrub gnyis las/ dang po la gsum/ pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ mo rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ 'khor rkyang du sgrub pa'o// dang po la'ang tshogs bdag gi tshul du sgrub pa/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ gnod sbyin ltar sgrub pa/ gshin rje ltar sgrub pa'o// 'di rnams la bsnyen sgrub las sbyor so so'i byed pa'i man ngag dang*/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags nas byed pa'i man ngag yod do// 'di'i las tshogs la gtor ma med par kha zas la brten te dgra bsad pa dang*/ dgra bgegs tshogs su za ba dang*/ byad sha spags pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i man ngag gis srog 'phrog pa la sogs pa bzhi yod do// gnyis pa mo rkyang du sgrub pa la/ zhi ba nang pa'i sgrub pa zhes pa bram ze mchog sred kyi bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa la brten nas bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag cig yod do// drag po gsang sngags phyi pa'i sgrub lugs zhes pa slob dpon lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba'i gzhung dang*/

de la brten pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag las bzhi kha bsgyur gyi man ngag zur tsam dang bcas pa yod do// 'di rig pa mchog gi rgyud na gsal bar bzhugs shing*/ lha mo nag mo'i gzungs ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba dang*/ gdan bzhi'i lhag gtor gyi skabs su bshad pa'i bstan srung chen mo yin la/ bla ma rngog pa rnams dud sol lha mo zhes pa'i mtshan dang*/ sngar gyi lo ka shrīs bsgyur ba'i gzhung de la bla ma nā ro pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs zhes par 'dogs so// gsum pa 'khor rkyang du sgrub pa la bzhi las dang po ni/ phyi'i las mkhan gcer bu zangs gri can dang*/ gnyis pa nang gi las mkhan ber nag zangs gri can/ de gnyis la'ang bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag khyad par du 'phags pa yod do// gsum pa gsang ba'i las mkhan pu tra lcam sring la mon pa ming sring lnga'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma mdor bsdus pa gcig dang*/ de la brten nas dam pa kun dga' grags kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum than 'gyed dang bcas pa/ brgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ rjes gnang gi yi ge rnams yod do// bzhi pa ni bran bdud gshin rje nag po la sogs pa'o// gnyis pa sbags sgrub la gnyis las/ dang po lcam dral sbags sgrub la mgon po dang lhan cig tu bskyed pa la bsnyen sgrub las gsum drag po'i sbyin sreg zur du kha 'phangs pa dang bcas pa bla ma chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa/ de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'dam du sbyar ba dang*/ gnyis pa lam gyi yan lag la rten gtor gyi man ngag gtor ma la brten te dgra bsad pa/ gsang rten lus la bcings pa/ de'i dmigs pa zab mo cig rnams yod do// gnyis pa mkha' 'gro'i sbags sgrub la/ 'jam zhing zhi ba'i las la yun bsrings te sgrub pa/ myur bar 'dod na dkyil 'khor la brten te rtsub mor sgrub pa/ shin tu myur bas zhag bdun gyis rtsal chen gyi las rdzogs pa/ rgyun du bsten pa zhi drag phyed mar sgrub pa ste man ngag bzhi po 'di dag re re la'ang bsnyen sgrub las gsum sbyar ba ste gsum gsum yod do// sgrub pa'i skabs su mkha' 'gro'i 'khu ldog spangs pa'i man ngag

las sbyor la bsad pa'i las dgu'o// 'di'i man ngag la mgon po'i bris sku bzhengs pa'i man ngag 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i bsam gtan gyi las sbyor rnams yod do// gnyis pa de rnams kyi man ngag lcam dral dang las mgon gsum gtso 'khor gsum sbags sgrub te sgrub pa la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi man ngag rtsa gsum la brten pa'i bsam gtan gyi las sbyor rnams yod do// gnyis pa de rnams kyi nang nas shin tu zab pa'i gdams pa ni/ rkyang sgrub rnams las sbags sgrub rnams zab cing*/ de la'ang lcam dral sbags sgrub dang*/ lha brgyad dang*/ lha bcu gnyis/ lha bcu bdun sbags te sgrub pa las/ snga ma snga ma las phyi ma phyi ma khyad par 'phags pa las/ rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa'i lugs yin/ de la'ang gnas skabs su bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las skyob cing*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub nus pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pa dang*/ yi dam la sogs pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ de'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa sngon chad chog mthong ba la sogs pa zhig dgos pa yin la/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni/ kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa dang*/ 'di'i rjes su gnang ba don du gnyer zhing dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa zhig la bya dgos pa yin la/ nam bya ba'i dus ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ yi dwags zla phyed bcu gnyis dang*// de bzhin du yang brgyad pa nyid// ces gsungs pa'i don/ yi dwags zhes pa 'dir 'byung po ste mkha' 'gro yin la/ de'i 'du ba'i dus ni yar ngo dang*/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ de bzhin du tshes brgyad gnyis te de rnams gang rung la bya dgos pa yin la/

gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos bskyang ba/ phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa zhig tu bya bar bshad la/ tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis dpal kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro chos skyong la mchod gtor 'bul ba dang*/ bzlas pa rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya ba'am/ tshogs 'khor yod na lhag gtor gyi bar bya dgos pas de rnams sngon du legs par grub nas/ gnyis pa khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams dgos pa las/ thog mar slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas/ rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis nas/ pad la 'dud/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma/ dpal nag po chen po lha brgyad la chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa ltar mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par mos/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyun bshags byas nas

'ga' zhig 'dir rigs lnga'i sdom gzung mdzad kyang dpe 'di'i dkyus su mi snang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung ba'i don du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon 'gro yin la/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba dang*/ yon tan phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba rnams su yod pa las thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyi slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa bskal pa'i me lta bu 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ khyed rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/ khyad par du rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po khams dang skye mched nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gnas pa'i sa phyogs su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mi ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du khyed rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ mthing nag re rer gyur par mos nas de las 'od 'phros/

dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po cher 'bar ba zhes pa nas/ steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon na khyi nag khengs shing zug pa/ rgyab na ce spyang bros ded byed pa/ mdun du mi nag gnam du 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na rigs lnga'i ngo bo khyung chen lding ba/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ ye shes kyi me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i g.yon phyogs su lus dang grib ma'i tshul du ṭām̐ las zhes sogs nas bh+yo'i sgra sgrogs pa'i sku can dang*/ de'i mdun du pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan re re'i steng du ya las sogs nas lan tshar can/ de gnyis kyi mdun du tri las pu tra sogs nas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i sku can re rer gsal lam gyis btab nas/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dpal nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka dang rang bzhin gyi gnas dang 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam/ chung ba rdul phran tsam tshad med grangs med pa'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku can du gsal ba'i sku lus kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams na mar mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar gnyis su med par thim pas lus kyi nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad nas sku'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

de bzhin du rang bzhin gyi gnas dang mdun bskyed kyi dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas dpal ldan lha mo gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra bha ṭa sring mo ral gcig ma dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang gis bsgoms pa'i las mgon so so la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing*/ ngag tu shā sa na dang*/ oṃ ro ru dang*/ a li a li sogs brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ khyad par du rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dpal kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po sngags kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje nag po chen po'i sku can du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po zhig gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la dpal kye rdo rje dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung ste/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la thim par mos nas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/

ces brjod la rang gi phreng ba 'dren du bcug la slob ma nyung na de ltar bya/ mang na mi thub/ gang ltar yang shā sa na dang*/ yi ge bdun ma rnams lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi dpal ldan lha mo gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams rdo rje nag po chen por gsal ba'i lte bar thim pas 'khor thams cad dbang du 'dus par mos nas sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ro ru dang*/ a li a li sogs lan gsum/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos nas/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor ste/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de nyid slob dpon gyis sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs dang gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas gong gi sku zhes pa'i tshab tu gsung zhes 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs rigs 'gre'o// thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

slob dpon dpal kye rdo rje zhes sogs nas thugs ka nas zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin las/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nas 'bras tsam bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug ba spu'i bu ga dbang po'i sgo la sogs pa rnams na mar gnyis su med par thim/ sems kyi nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad nas rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i ngo bor rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje gsor ba sogs gong bzhin bya'o// de ltar byin gyis brlabs pas sogs gsung dang thugs 'don pa spo ba ma gtogs rigs 'gre'o// de'i mtha' rten du yon tan phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mtshan mo yin na dpal 'bar 'dzugs/ nyin mo 'dzugs mi dgos so// slob dpon gyis mgon po'i gtor ma slob ma'i mgo bor bzhag las mgon gyi gtor ma lag tu gtad la/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor nas bzhugs par mos/ de'i steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad tho brtsegs su bzhugs par mos te/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya sa ma ya sma ra sogs dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī sa ma ya sogs dang*/ a li a li ma sogs nas sma ra sa ma ya ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/

ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bram ze mchog sred/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrar+dhā ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ gzar chen sangs rgyas dpal ldan/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen mchog grub/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ bdag cag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin bkra shis grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du'ang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig 'di rnams chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin sa mdzod cig steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po dang*/ the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig

mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ legs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas zas gos longs spyod kyis phongs pa med par yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa'i phrin las mdzod cig rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyis dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis mi thul ba med pas/ mngon spyod kyi las kyis tshar bcad nas bsam pa ngan pa dang sbyor ba rtsub pa thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mdor na rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ ji srid yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig de nas slob dpon gyis nas nag mgo thog tu bzhag cing lag tu byin par mos pa mdzod byas la/ shā sa na 'don bzhin pas nas nag spyi bor bzhag cing lag tu'ang sbyin no// de ltar bka' bsgos pas mdun gyi gtor ma'i steng gi rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku las de 'dra ba'i rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku mthe bong gi tshad tsam pa dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying pad+ma 'dab brgyad du gyur pa'i lte bar rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa 'bral med du bzhugs pa'i pad+ma kha zum pa'i steng du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa res rgyas btab ste/ dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ 'gal rkyen thams cad sel ba dang*/

mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub par mos pa mdzod/ de ltar bsgoms pas 'di'i 'khor gyi gnod pa dang*/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'di'i sgo nas gzhan gyis mnan gtad gzer gsum byas pa rnams kyis mi tshugs pa'i gdams ngag mchog tu gyur pa yin no// des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes mi 'bral bar bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa po chos skyong dang mi 'bral ba'i ched du khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du byed pa dang*/ bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi chos zhus pa'i bla ma la gus par bya ba dang*/ khyad par rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gdams ngag zhus pa'i bla ma dang chos brgyud la dad cing gus par byas pas lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khor ba chos nyid yin pas de ltar bya dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa chos skyong sgrub pa po dang mi 'bral ba ni/ 'di'i rjes gnang legs par thob phyin chad rab kyis thun bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis sam/ tha mas kyang thun gcig la sogs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes brgyad gnyis dang*/ yar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ mar ngo'i bcu bzhi sogs la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ rang gis mi shes na gzhan 'bul du gzhug pa la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no// de ltar phul ba'i dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/ sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir// rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bsten// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de bzhin du gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi rdo ba bzhin// kha ru dbyung bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos thams cad gsang nas nyams su len dgos la/ khyad par rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor dang*/ rjes su gnang ba dang*/ gdams pa la sogs pa ston pa'i tshe/

dbang ma thob pa dang dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la gsang dgos pa yin no// gsang ba'i chos mi 'dod pa la ston pa ni yan lag gi ltung bar bshad pa yin no// 'o na rtsa ba nas gsang ba yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ man ngag gser gyi yang zhun ni// snod ldan gcig la nub mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma re re tsam la ster na'ang bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bstan dgos pa yin no// gzhan yang 'khor du gtogs pa'i bya nag khyi nag sogs la rdo mi 'phen pa dang*/ mi nag dang*/ a tsa ra dang*/ mon pa pho mo la sogs pa 'khor du bsten pa'am bsten mi nus na longs spyod kyis mnyes par bya ba la bslab dgos par bshad pa yin no// mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa slob dpon la drin lan du phul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs brjod/ des rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i chos srung dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad sbags te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ gsum pa mjug ni/ yi ge brgya pa sogs rjes kyi bya ba rnams gtor chog ltar bya'o// de ltar bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo mchog /rdo rje nag po chen po lha brgyad kyi// rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di// gzhan don mdzad pa dag gis bskul phyir bris// 'di la lhag chad 'gal 'khrul gyur pa rnams// bla ma mchog dang nag po che la bshags// dge des bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi// phyi nang 'gal rkyen zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di ni rje btsun e wam̐ pa chen po dkon mchog dpal ldan gyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa sharaṃ paṃ byams pa kunaṃ dgaṃ' bkraṃ shiṃs grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sa pho spre'u'i lo sa ga zla ba'i yar ngo'i gral tshes bcu bzhi pa mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus la shrī e wam̐ chos ldan du dge bar sbyar ba'o//

//bkra shis// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
